messages:
anya: quick follow-up from the postmortem  we need to lock owners and dates for remediation items: token TTL drift, missing audit events, and the outstanding secret rotations. keeping it compact here.
sarah: good call. i can take audit pipeline and the pre/post rotate validation checklist.
mike: i'll own the token validation tooling and CI job. planning to add a daily smoke and an alert if >1% tokens exceed target.
daniel: will take the rotate-run and update the rotation playbook. need to confirm maintenance window preferences (low-traffic friday vs saturday early am).
anya: suggested TTL policy: interactive (user) tokens <=30d, service tokens <=7d, machine-to-machine ephemeral <=1d. putting that in runbook draft.
sarah: noted. i'll raise infra ticket to increase audit log retention to 90d org-wide and 365d for enterprise customers. will sync with compliance team before change.
infra-bot: Created ticket: INFRA-4789  audit retention update (https://tracker.redwood/INFRA-4789)
mike: draft CI snippet i'll add:
```bash
# token ttl smoke
python scripts/check_token_ttl.py --env prod --max-service-ttl 7 --max-user-ttl 30
```
I'll add a PagerDuty alert if the job reports more than 1% violation.
anya: secrets summary: ops-catalog shows 12 secrets flagged as stale across prod/staging. can someone run the bulk rotate after pre-checks?
daniel: i can run bulk rotate next Fri 2026-04-10 09:00 PT, estimate 90-120m with a short maintenance page. will post rollback steps and a verification script.
sarah: pre-rotate checklist i'm drafting: 1) map consumers per secret 2) verify no direct mounts with `kubectl get pods -o jsonpath` 3) snapshot audit events before rotate 4) brief key-rotation notice to downstream teams. will add to the ticket.
mike: note: client SDK credential refresh behavior might need slight tweaks; i'll open a doc PR and ping client teams.
anya: action list (to be added to remediation tracker sheet):
- mike: implement token ttl CI + PD alert  due 2026-04-02
- sarah: INFRA-4789 + implement audit retention bump + pre/post rotate checklist  due 2026-03-30
- daniel: execute bulk secret rotate + verification run  due 2026-04-10
- anya: finalize TTL policy in runbook + close loop with product/security  due 2026-03-27
sarah: adding tasks to the remediation tracker: https://docs.redwood/remediation/2026-q1-sweep
mike: quick question  which services missed audit events? i observed gaps in env-proxy and authz-service.
anya: confirm env-proxy had sampling enabled on a subset of nodes (accidental), and authz-service had a regression that filtered rotation events out of the pipeline. ENG-5975 and ENG-5976 created.
eng-platform: noted and assigned ENG-5975 (env-proxy sampling flip) to platform-ops (https://tracker.redwood/ENG-5975).
anya: if nobody objects i'll close this thread and track progress in the remediation board. re-open here if anything blocks or new owners are needed :thumbsup:
